outcome: Record who requested each Requirement intake and each Control Intent, so an owner request is distinguishable from a decision the Loop made on its own.
non_goals: Do not add multi-user authorisation semantics or access control lists
The subject is an identity reference, never a credential and never stored as one

transitions.reason: the owner will keep a single-user server but wants the record to show who asked; identity cannot be reconstructed later, so it is recorded now while authorisation stays out of scope
Luna threading the requester through the layers

an owner request and a loop decision are now distinguishable in canonical state for intake and control, legacy records stay readable and omit the field rather than being backfilled, and the domain change is a value addition with every transition function untouched
